envelope.description: Serialize coalesced progress persistence with task results

body.title: Serialize coalesced progress persistence with task results
body.summary: Reuse per-review serial writer; latest-only coalescing,5sec routine writes, immediate boundary flush, generation fencing and timer disposal. Never overwrite newer results or input; progress write failure is best effort while task-result failure remains fail-stop. At most one pending progress flush, including rapid phase changes; serial task/result boundaries remain authoritative.
acceptanceChecks: High-rate events retain one pending snapshot; routine writes bounded to5sec
Late queued writes cannot overwrite task results; timer stopped on retirement; failures retain last durable observation
Rapid phase alternation cannot create an unbounded write queue

tests.name: Coalesces progress writes and fences stale generations without corrupting results
Retains durable feedback when progress persistence fails
